flags.purpose: Retrieve configuration of a specific firewall profile (Domain, Private, Public).
flags.security_use_case: Ensure Public profile is most restrictive for untrusted networks.
flags.threat_detected: Disabled firewall, permissive inbound rules, missing log configuration.
flags.detection_pattern: Public profile Enabled = False OR DefaultInboundAction = Allow OR LogFileName empty.
flags.forensic_value: Shows if system was exposed to unsolicited inbound traffic during compromise.
flags.baseline_value: Public profile should always be Enabled with DefaultInboundAction = Block and logging enabled.
flags.safe_followup: Use Set-NetFirewallProfile to enforce restrictive defaults; audit rules with Get-NetFirewallRule.

flags.purpose: Retrieve configuration of all firewall profiles in one command.
flags.security_use_case: Detect inconsistent security posture across Domain, Private, and Public profiles.
flags.threat_detected: One profile weaker than others creating a security gap.
flags.detection_pattern: Any profile where Enabled = False OR DefaultInboundAction = Allow.
flags.forensic_value: Helps identify which network context allowed unwanted traffic.
flags.baseline_value: All profiles Enabled, Inbound Blocked, logging active.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Displays full firewall posture including logging critical for investigations.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Verify inbound is blocked and logs exist for incident review.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds profiles allowing unsolicited inbound connections.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Critical misconfiguration exposing system to attack.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Locates firewall log file for analysis of dropped or allowed traffic.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Essential during incident response to trace connection attempts.
